input._script:
using CUDA
using JSON3

function jacc_vadd_i(i, y, a, b)
    y[i] = a[i] + b[i]
end

result = Dict{String,Any}()
input = JSON3.read(ARGS[1])
a_host = Float32.(input.a)
b_host = Float32.(input.b)
n = length(a_host)

ndevices = length(CUDA.devices())
result["devices_visible"] = ndevices
if ndevices < 2
    result["error"] = "expected 2 visible GPUs, got $ndevices -- check --gres in run_job_multi_gpu_single_node_a30.sbatch"
    println(JSON3.write(result))
    exit(1)
end

function vadd_kernel!(y, a, b)
    i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
    if i <= length(y)
        @inbounds y[i] = a[i] + b[i]
    end
    return nothing
end

cuda_per_device = Dict{String,Any}()
for dev in CUDA.devices()
    try
        CUDA.device!(dev)
        a_dev = CuArray(a_host)
        b_dev = CuArray(b_host)
        y_dev = CUDA.zeros(Float32, n)
        threads = 256
        blocks = cld(n, threads)
        @cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks vadd_kernel!(y_dev, a_dev, b_dev)
        CUDA.synchronize()
        cuda_per_device[string(dev)] = Dict("result" => Array(y_dev), "name" => CUDA.name(dev))
    catch e
        cuda_per_device[string(dev)] = Dict("error" => sprint(showerror, e))
    end
end
result["cuda"] = cuda_per_device

jacc_per_device = Dict{String,Any}()
# import must be its own completed top-level statement before any code
# that uses JACC.@macro: Julia macro-expands an entire top-level block
# before executing any of it, so import JACC and JACC.@init_backend
# cannot share one try block -- the macro would resolve before the
# import has run.
jacc_import_ok = true
try
    ENV["JACC_BACKEND"] = "CUDA"
    import JACC
catch e
    jacc_per_device["init"] = Dict("error" => "import JACC failed: $(sprint(showerror, e))")
    global jacc_import_ok = false
end
if jacc_import_ok
    try
        JACC.@init_backend
        for dev in CUDA.devices()
            try
                CUDA.device!(dev)
                a_j = JACC.array(a_host)
                b_j = JACC.array(b_host)
                y_j = JACC.zeros(Float32, n)
                # JACC.parallel_for(dims, f, x...) calls f(i, x...) per index.
                # f must be a named function -- confirmed via
                # methods(JACC.parallel_for) on 2026-09-05; JACC's macro
                # form and JACC.Array do not exist as this health check
                # originally assumed.
                JACC.parallel_for(n, jacc_vadd_i, y_j, a_j, b_j)
                JACC.synchronize()
                jacc_per_device[string(dev)] = Dict("result" => Array(y_j))
            catch e
                jacc_per_device[string(dev)] = Dict("error" => sprint(showerror, e))
            end
        end
    catch e
        jacc_per_device["init"] = Dict("error" => sprint(showerror, e))
    end
end
result["jacc"] = jacc_per_device

println(JSON3.write(result))
